title: Case #1 — MIGHTEE deep field (SKA-Mid AA*)
description: MIGHTEE COSMOS field, 4 h with SKA-Mid AA* (64 x 13.5 m MeerKAT + 80 x 15 m SKA dishes) in Band 2: 1310 MHz centre, 720 MHz in 64 channels of 11.25 MHz, 8 s integrations. Sky: 487 MIGHTEE DR1 COSMOS components (Hale et al. 2025) with their deconvolved sizes, plus 9632 T-RECS sources (Bonaldi et al. 2019) below the MIGHTEE completeness limit, trimmed to the 0.2 deg image (10119 components, flat spectrum). Thermal noise from per-antenna SEFDs (461 Jy MeerKAT, 304 Jy SKA dishes, eta_c 0.95), no RFI flagging. Natural-weight thermal rms 0.58 uJy/beam. Two WSClean multiscale images, 8 output channels joined, 100000 iterations, mgain 0.8, auto-threshold 0.3, auto-mask 3: Briggs robust 0.5 at 1024 x 1024 px of 0.703 arcsec, and Briggs robust -1 at 2048 x 2048 px of 0.352 arcsec (both 0.2 deg); plus an OSKAR dirty image.
